implementation.entry_points: Desktop message context menus and mobile long-press sheets open a Turkish/English reminder manager with one-hour, tomorrow, next-week and custom date-time choices.
implementation.authorization: Creation resolves current channel read permissions or DM membership and verifies that the supplied message belongs to the supplied conversation. List, edit and cancel are scoped to the authenticated owner.
implementation.persistence: Migration 107 stores private scheduled, delivered and cancelled reminders. Server startup launches a durable scheduler; reminders survive client and server restarts.
implementation.exactly_once: The repository changes a scheduled reminder to delivered and inserts the system notification in one database transaction guarded by status='scheduled'. Concurrent workers cannot insert a second notification for the same reminder.
implementation.delivery: The notification carries the original server/channel/message or DM-channel/message navigation target and is broadcast only after the transaction commits.
